name: True Love
overview: True love, as revealed in Scripture, is rooted in sacrificial commitment and divine example. Jacob's willingness to serve seven years for Rachel illustrates the dedication involved in finding true love, while Jesus commands believers to love one another as He loved them, setting the highest standard of love. Moreover, God's love is demonstrated supremely in the giving of His Son for eternal life to believers, emphasizing that true love is both selfless and redemptive. This love requires a heart transformed by being born again and a single devotion to God, for one cannot serve both God and worldly desires.
